# S2 — BriefBridge

> Fixture data. Not market evidence.

## Synthetic control text

The client call ended with three decisions.

The first follow-up remembered two.

BriefBridge is a fictional drafting tool for small agencies. It reads the completed call transcript, finds the assigned owner and date when they were stated, and prepares a follow-up email for review.

In a synthetic agency fixture, manual drafts took a median 16 minutes and omitted at least one assigned detail in 19% of records. BriefBridge drafts took a synthetic median 5 minutes. Those numbers are invented control labels, not customer results.

The promise is deliberately narrow: carry the commitments already made on the call into the first draft. BriefBridge does not send the email, invent an owner, or claim that a faster draft closes more work.

Bring one completed call transcript to a walkthrough.
